paper_title: Inhomogeneous Energy Injection in the 21-cm Power Spectrum: Sensitivity to Dark Matter Decay
notes: This paper develops a simulation framework (DM21cm) for modeling dark matter decay effects on the 21-cm power spectrum and uses it to forecast projected constraints from future HERA observations. The paper does not report measured experimental or observational limits, only theoretical projections for dark matter decay to photons and electrons. Out of scope per task card guidelines on projections and sensitivity forecasts.
